rationale: No supported optimization's preconditions are cleanly met for this workflow without violating the constraints. The matrix resolves to a single job (Julia 1 / ubuntu-latest / x64), so P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (cancel remaining matrix jobs after failure) has nothing to cancel and toggling fail-fast would not save work. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE would require GitHub API calls (new network access and a token) and the workflow also runs on tags, which is a release/deployment contraindication. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT and P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT need representative successful-duration history, but the CI history contains only one run and it failed, so no safe timeout can be derived. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is already present (actions/cache@v3 keyed by Project.toml), triggering the 'an equivalent cache already exists' contraindication, and the cache key does not include the Julia version/arch environment, so adding or altering a dependency cache is not a minimal safe change. Build and test coverage is preserved as-is.
